methodology.notes: Custom native broker transport and per-turn Runtime Attempts. DeepSeek Flash (non-thinking, temperature 0, max_tokens 2048) is BOTH agent and user simulator; this is not the default GPT-4.1 simulator configuration. Official prompts, tasks, policies, tools and ALL evaluator unchanged. Airline base: every one of 50 tasks, four fresh trials (seeds300-303); all outcomes preserved. One upstream failure interrupted the initial run after160complete simulations. Recovery preserves all160 verbatim, records the original failure using the official infrastructure-error envelope, restarts only the unfinished task, and continues39untouched tasks. Completed simulations are never rerun; reward0 is never retried. Task-level provider recovery is bounded to one further attempt per pending task, with original uncertain charges retained. No transparent HTTP replay. Only Runtime arm rerun; no new paired-direct superiority claim. Credential-free worker preloader reused; each inference Attempt remains a fresh process. The source git_commit metadata is unknown because the new worktree ownership check initially failed; source receipt independently verifies all Runtime files against the frozen implementation, and raw trajectory metadata remains unchanged. Cumulative budget authorization increased from CNY10 to CNY20 during evaluation; an audited carry-forward preserves historical spending and call counts, without any task/model change or replay. Cost metadata normalized to official Flash PEAK USD list rates dated 2026-11-17, not actual off-peak invoice. Private email withheld; please contact GitHub @Tzddd6.
